items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Frank Sinatra before this. And then after this, Mancini, so that was the concept.

ctx.x: So we came up with the concept. Frank Sinatra before this. And then after this, Mancini, so that was the concept. But that’s how that came about. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
Does that bother you at all? That you need to do a concept?
